title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-08-18
taper: From the Collection of Jeff Knudsen

ai_review.summary: A stellar audience recording that captures the historic debut of Truckin', Ripple, Brokedown Palace and Operator with surprisingly clear sound.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this audience‑sourced tape as a crucial piece of Dead history, noting the crystal‑clear transfer that lets listeners hear early versions of Truckin', Ripple, Brokedown Palace and Operator for the first time. The performance itself is described as epic and lovingly documented, making the set a must‑hear despite the lack of a soundboard source.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews are highly positive (4–5 stars) and emphasize both historic musical importance and excellent audience‑recording clarity, indicating a strong show and good recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape praised for its clear, well‑transferred sound despite not being a soundboard; listeners describe it as 'killer' and 'so clearly' hearing the music.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Historic set featuring early renditions of several signature songs; reviewers highlight the significance and energy of the performance.
